instruct: A soft-spoken young Welsh woman, mid-low pitch, unhurried, with the measured cadence of someone reading aloud from an old book. Her tone is warm, knowing, and faintly amused, with a quiet sing-song undertone in the vowels. Never raised, never rushed.

text: Come in — I was just reading. Sit with me a moment, and I'll show you what the text actually says about her. It isn't what the song claims. It almost never is.
